leads.name: Real-time joint audio-video generation by parallel adapter composition (2026)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: v2 names the authors (Jingyu Li, Xiaoxiao Xiang, Yiwen Guo) but there is no lab of note and no venue yet (ICLR 2027 submission), and its 26 fps, 30-second streaming audio-video at 480x832 is represented by shengshu--vidu-s1.

leads.name: DiffuPlex (arXiv 2610.12214)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: a single-author 1.5-1.8x speed-up of existing full-duplex dialogue models with no new interaction capability, and the project page loads audio samples only by script.
